```plato

    //==
    // # Metaball influence and summation
    //
    // Summed radial falloff kernels over the metaball types declared in
    // `implicit-sdf.types.plato`. The system's field value is the total
    // influence minus the threshold, so its zero level set is the blob boundary
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metaballs).

    // The influence of one planar ball at a point: Strength at the centre, falling
    // smoothly to zero at Radius and staying zero beyond it.
    InfluenceAt(self: MetaBall2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.Strength * MetaBallFalloff(self.Center.Between(point).Magnitude / self.Radius);
```

    // The influence of one spatial ball at a point; negative strengths carve.
    InfluenceAt(self: MetaBall3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => self.Strength * MetaBallFalloff(self.Center.Between(point).Magnitude / self.Radius);
